faq.q: What is the best time to visit Alleppey?
faq.a: The best time to visit Alleppey is Sep – Mar. Summers are 26–34°C and winters are 23–32°C.

The nearest airport is Alleppey / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Ernakulam Junction (Kochi) (53 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Alleppey at a relaxed pace.
